title: Phenol-Chloroform Extraction for dsRNA Purification
author: Cera Fisher
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.4pmgvk6
materials: Move aqueous phase (top) to new tube

steps.title: Prepare Sample
steps.instruction: Prepare the initial sample by adding water and transferring to a microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 166.6 uL of nuclease free water to each PCR tube.
Move 187 uL of liquid to a new, labeled 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Perform First Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract the sample using acid phenol/chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 uL of acid phenol/chloroform (50:50) to each tube.
Shake vigorously for 15 seconds.
Centrifuge at 4C for 5 minutes at 12,000 * g or greater.

steps.title: Perform Second Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Further purify the aqueous phase using chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Move the aqueous phase (top, about 200 uL) to a new tube.
Add an equal volume of chloroform to the aqueous phase.
Shake vigorously for 15 seconds.
Centrifuge at 4C for 5 minutes at 12,000 * g or greater.
Add an equal volume of isopropanol to the sample.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Spin at 4C for 20 minutes at 12,000 * g or greater to pellet.

steps.title: Wash and Dry Pellet
steps.instruction: Clean the pellet with ethanol and air dry.

substeps.instruction: Remove isopropanol.
Wash pellet with 75% ethanol in nuclease free water.
Spin at 4C for 5 minutes at 7,500 * g.
Remove all ethanol from pellet and let air dry for about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend and Heat Treat dsRNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet and apply heat treatment.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend dried pellet in 50 uL of nuclease free water.
Heat resuspended dsRNA to between 65 and 80 degrees C for 5 minutes.
Allow to cool at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Place on ice.

steps.title: Add Ammonium Acetate
steps.instruction: Add ammonium acetate to the treated sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 13.33 uL of ammonium acetate to each tube.
